D/ IMP VL PHILIPPUS AVG ; R/ PMSC

A copper sestertius of Philip I the Arab, dating to the period 244 AD- 249 AD, (Reece Period 12). Obverse legend reads ' IMP VL PHILIPPUS AVG'. Reverse legend reads 'PMSC' with 'ANVIII' across the bottom of the coin. The 'PMSC' is an abbreviation of Provinciae Moesiae Superioris Colonia Viminacium . The numerals indicate that the coin was minted in the eighth year of Roman colonial rule in Moesia…
